purpose: Dates every published BF6 game update so creator videos, guides and EA statements can be matched to the game version that was live when they were made.
source: EA news listings https://www.ea.com/games/battlefield/battlefield-6/news?page=N&type=latest (pages 1-11) and the REDSEC news listing. Articles: every non-update article on both listings whose title suggests mechanics, guides, community updates or roadmaps (excluded: anticheat, twitch drops, battle pass, creator program, sales, Red Bull, challenge and bonus-path guides, esports, cosmetics).
dating: Use verified releaseDate for update dating. articleDate is publication, often earlier than rollout. A null releaseDate leaves rollout unresolved; treat content within two days of a known release as ambiguous. Later item-specific patch changes limit community tests to their own version.
limits: Listings were read through a page summariser; the REDSEC pass found one community update (15 Jul 2026) missing from the BF6 pass, so other articles may be missing. A session with full web access should re-crawl both listings and add any gaps.
Hotfixes without an EA article are not listed (e.g. the 1.4.3.1 client in builds/1.4.3.0).
Only metadata and links are stored; patch note text is not copied.
gadgetVehicleChanges, weaponAttachmentChanges and mechanicsRead are null until read: fill them with short own-words summaries and the touched items.

gadgetVehicleChanges.summary: Launcher guidance, blast checks and damage changed. Ladder deployment, beacon limits, drone flight, resupply and detection were revised.

weaponAttachmentChanges.summary: Recoil, movement accuracy, automatic spread, shotgun lethality, slug feedback and bolt first-shot behavior changed.

updates.releaseDateNote: Article date is October 9; launch wording supplies no separate explicit rollout day.

gadgetVehicleChanges.summary: Gadget traversal, resupply and debris persistence were fixed. Anti-tank grenade craters shrank. Tank feedback and external-seat presentation were corrected.

weaponAttachmentChanges.summary: Dispersion was rebalanced by damage. Non-Recon sniper spread penalty became zoom sway. Optic, bipod and suppressor costs were fixed.

gadgetVehicleChanges.summary: Flares counter lock-guided missiles correctly; drone climbing exploit and vehicle spawns were fixed.

weaponAttachmentChanges.summary: Sprint-to-ADS and movement-dependent dispersion errors were corrected.

gadgetVehicleChanges.summary: Assault spawn grenades, IFV missile damage, helicopter hitboxes and targeting were fixed. Gadget supply, placement, hit registration and drone pushing were corrected.

weaponAttachmentChanges.summary: Dispersion fell; DMR recoil and automatic range balance changed. Slugs, optics, lasers, attachment placement and stat display were fixed.

gadgetVehicleChanges.summary: Ladder angle, knife accuracy and mortar smoke supply changed. Supply Pouch healing lost its instant component. Vehicle damage zones and Breakthrough distributions were corrected.

weaponAttachmentChanges.summary: Mini Scout pacing slowed; recoil magnitude and randomness were rebalanced. Large LMG magazine cost and movement penalty fell; FMJ transfer was fixed.

weaponAttachmentChanges.summary: Bipod bonus display, optic cost, short-barrel aim and muzzle-speed modifiers were corrected. Melee timing and controller recoil were refined.

gadgetVehicleChanges.summary: UAV detection sound is limited to its operator.

weaponAttachmentChanges.summary: No direct weapon or attachment balance change is stated.

weaponAttachmentChanges.summary: Recoil and compensation were revised. Spotting radii, Mini Scout speed, fast magazines, scope visibility and barrel descriptions changed.

gadgetVehicleChanges.summary: Mask revive interruption, Recon pulse activation and armoured-vehicle mask voice cues were fixed.

weaponAttachmentChanges.summary: Weapon skin rendering was refined; no numeric balance change is stated.

gadgetVehicleChanges.summary: Dirt bikes arrived. Guided vehicle missiles slowed. Transport handling, UH-79 health, mine lifetime/count and drone visibility changed; mortar deployment and direct hits improved.

weaponAttachmentChanges.summary: New guns, sights, violet laser and tactical lights arrived. Bipod, dispersion, reload and attachment presentation errors were fixed.

gadgetVehicleChanges.summary: C-RAM visibility and automatic grenade looting were fixed.

weaponAttachmentChanges.summary: Variable-scope hand obstruction was corrected.

gadgetVehicleChanges.summary: LTV arrived; RHIB handling improved. Scout weapons, attack rockets, launcher guidance and defibrillator charges changed. C4 inventory and REDSEC supply/destruction were fixed.

weaponAttachmentChanges.summary: New machete, ammunition costs, range-finder sounds and DB-12/M87A1 transitions changed. TH-RDS recoil and violet-laser benefit were fixed.

gadgetVehicleChanges.summary: Vehicle names and deployment presentation corrected.

weaponAttachmentChanges.summary: Revived DMR appearance corrected.

gadgetVehicleChanges.summary: Mortar counterplay, launcher trajectories, Claymore range and mobile AA options changed.

weaponAttachmentChanges.summary: Burst modifiers limited to burst; extended barrel benefit removed and cost reduced.

weaponAttachmentChanges.summary: Ballistics, recoil variation, body multipliers and dispersion changed; sniper ranges narrowed.

gadgetVehicleChanges.summary: Naval vehicles added; launcher reload and REDSEC cluster ammunition adjusted.

weaponAttachmentChanges.summary: Water ballistics and attachment presentation changed; new barrels and optics added.

gadgetVehicleChanges.summary: Smoke slope damage and tank reload selection corrected.
